items.t: Evaluated on the LayerLens platform, the AI tutoring system Elumai scored 90.0% across all 1,473 examples of Scale AI's TutorBench benchmark. No general-purpose model that LayerLens has evaluated on TutorBench scored above 63.0%.
Speridlabs' Idol model, which turns images of an object into a 3D Gaussian splat, can now run locally on a Mac. Speridlabs credited the Hugging Face team for the work.

Hub released Release #2 of its HubEgo-100K egocentric dataset on Hugging Face, adding more than 20,000 hours of skilled work recorded by over 20,000 contributors in more than 28,000 environments. The dataset is free to use under a CC BY 4.0 license.

LayerLens updated Composite Environments, which test an AI agent across every app it uses in a single run, so teams can now include their own in-house tools and edit a test without losing earlier results. Each run is graded against known answers, and every tool call is saved for review.
prime-rl 0.11.0 has been released, with a new pretraining entrypoint and a major improvement in training performance. The release was announced by @samsja19 and reposted by Prime Intellect.
